reviews.text: I LOVE this salon and especially my stylist Jenerika!! All of the stylists are highly trained in a variety of salon services. From cuts to color, to Brazilian blowouts and extensions, Jenerika will have you looking like a million bucks!!
Great experience! Loved the atmosphere, Jenerika made me feel so comfortable and welcomed. The results were exactly what I wanted. Totally worth the hour drive.
Love working with Joanna to help my hair visions come to life. She is very devoted to making sure you get a result you love!
